## Row 1 {data-height=700, data-padding=15}

### Map

```{r, echo=FALSE,message=FALSE, fig.align='center'}
knitr::include_graphics("SARD/cave.png")
```

### Note

Detected species has been calculated by removing every OTU that had less than 90 query coverage and less than 99% pident. The pident treshold has been chosen following Egeter et al. 2022. The coverage treshold has been chosen arbitrarly

## Row 1 {data-height=1500, data-padding=15}

### detected species 

<div id="SPECIES_CO1" class="graph-container">
```{r, echo=FALSE}
thematic::thematic_rmd(font = "auto")
load("SARD/SEPT24/CO1/DETECT_SPECIES.RDATA")
datatable(DETECT_SPECIES, options = list(
  pageLength = 10,   # Set the number of rows visible initially
  scrollY = 500,     # Enable vertical scrolling with a fixed height
  scrollX = TRUE# Enable horizontal scrolling for wide tables
), width = "10%")
```
</div>

<div id="SPECIES_28S" class="graph-container" style="display: none;">

<script>
  function showGraphs(graphType) {
    console.log("Switching to:", graphType); // Debugging

    if (graphType === "co1") {
      document.getElementById("NMDS_CO1").style.display = "block";
      document.getElementById("NMDS_28S").style.display = "none";
      document.getElementById("KRONA_CO1").style.display = "block";
      document.getElementById("KRONA_28S").style.display = "none";
      document.getElementById("SPECIES_CO1").style.display = "block";
      document.getElementById("SPECIES_28S").style.display = "none";


      // Force reload of iframes
      document.getElementById("iframe_NMDS_CO1").src += "";
      document.getElementById("iframe_KRONA_CO1").src += "";
    } else if (graphType === "28s") {
      document.getElementById("NMDS_CO1").style.display = "none";
      document.getElementById("NMDS_28S").style.display = "block";
      document.getElementById("KRONA_CO1").style.display = "none";
      document.getElementById("KRONA_28S").style.display = "block";
      document.getElementById("SPECIES_CO1").style.display = "none";
      document.getElementById("SPECIES_28S").style.display = "block";


      // Force reload of iframes
      document.getElementById("iframe_NMDS_28S").src += "";
      document.getElementById("iframe_KRONA_28S").src += "";
    }
  }
</script>
